task_completion.visual_evidence: Code snippets in a terminal or editor showing the 0.5/N adjustment logic and d-prime calculation (Z(Hit) - Z(FA)).

task_completion.visual_evidence: Code or terminal output showing the identification of sub-99 as an outlier or the application of the exclusion filters.

task_completion.description: Agent generates the final JSON report at ~/pebl/analysis/gng_report.json
task_completion.visual_evidence: A terminal command showing the creation of the file or the file appearing in a file manager.

task_completion.description: The report contains individual metrics for participants and a 'group_means' section with all six required metrics
task_completion.visual_evidence: A screenshot of the gng_report.json file showing 'participants' (with id, omission_errors, commission_errors, hit_rate, false_alarm_rate, mean_hit_rt_ms, d_prime) and 'group_means' keys.

integrity.description: Agent performs actual data analysis rather than hardcoding values from the task description
integrity.visual_evidence: Presence of data processing code (Python/R) that reads the CSV and performs math, rather than a single echo command writing a pre-made JSON.

integrity.description: Agent uses the specific file paths provided in the instructions
Agent correctly identifies the corrupted record (sub-99) through analysis
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal output or code comments specifically flagging sub-99 for exclusion based on the 0.90 FA rate or low RT.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The dataset contains 25 valid participants (sub-01 to sub-25) and one corrupted participant (sub-99). sub-99 has a 100% response rate (FA Rate = 1.0) and an average RT of ~17.5ms, which triggers both exclusion criteria (FA Rate ≥ 0.90 and RT < 100ms). The agent must apply the 0.5/N correction to Hit/FA rates of 0 or 1 before calculating Z-scores for d-prime. The final report must be at ~/pebl/analysis/gng_report.json.
